chunks: And God did not do so but as good tidings for you, and to reassure your hearts for victory comes from God alone, the all-mighty and all-wise --
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of God's actions for believers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Battle of Badr, highlighting that divine victory serves not merely as military success but as a spiritual reassurance (tuma'ninah) for the believers' hearts. It underscores the theological principle that while human effort is necessary, true al-Nasr (victory) is exclusively from Allah, affirming His attributes of Al-Aziz (The Mighty) and Al-Hakim (The Wise).
